verdict.rationale: Name.com's first-party docs describe a dedicated API endpoint for creating webhook subscriptions to real-time domain and account events (transfers, renewals). They also name specific event types such as `domain.transfer.status_change` and `domain.registry.compliance_notice`, and the renewals guide references webhooks. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that webhook delivery works reliably, and docs on payload signing and retry behavior.
